question.text: Which document is the primary source of scheme-specific information about a mutual fund scheme for investors?

explanation.text: The Logic: Per p95, the SID contains details of the particular scheme. p96-p97 set out SID contents in detail. Together, SID and SAI are the primary source documents for investors (p96), with SID providing the scheme-specific details (investment objective, asset allocation, risk factors, fees, fund manager, performance data). The Trap: SAI contains statutory information common to all schemes of an AMC (sponsor, trustee, service providers) — not scheme-specific details. KIM is a summarised version. Fact Sheets are non-mandatory (p111). Note: For detailed scheme-specific questions (investment strategy, asset allocation, fees), the SID is the document to consult.
